'''Tech Team Senth''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military unit. They were deployed to [[Raid on Saarn|face]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]].
